newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee weakens vs forward dlr, steady in spot.
newsitem.headline: India rupee weakens vs forward dlr, steady in spot.

text.p: The rupee weakened against the forward dollar in afternoon trade Monday but the spot rupee was little changed at 35.725/735, dealers said.
March 1997 delivery dollars were quoted at a premium of 1.14/1.17 rupees in early afternoon trade compared to opening quotes of 1.10/1.12.
Near-month premiums also firmed up with September dollars at 0.17/0.19 rupees against the opening 0.16/0.18, dealers said.
"There is no real demand from importers," said a dealer.
"It looks like today's rise (in forward premiums) is speculation-driven," he said.

One dealer said the market was reacting to a statement by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) deputy governor on the weekend that the rupee is overvalued on the basis of real effective exchange rate (REER).
"Last week, the RBI allowed foreign funds forward cover on their (Indian) debt investments," said another dealer.
"This also appears to have swayed the sentiment."
